effect_description_eng:
[When Digivolving] For each yellow and/or red Tamer you have in play, 1 of your opponent's Digimon and all of your opponent's Security Digimon get -3000 DP for the turn.
[Your Turn] All of your [Marcus Damon] in play get +3000 DP and gain ＜Security A. +1＞ (This Digimon checks 1 additional security card.)
